name: cast_vote
description: Casts your vote on the team's work during a discussion round with active voting. ALWAYS use this instead of (or in addition to) the text marker 'VOTO: ...': it's the reliable way to make your vote count.

vote.description: APPROVO if the work is satisfactory; MODIFICARE if changes are needed (specify them in reason); RIFIUTO if the work is wrong and must be redone.
